description: WRITE: create a user — typically a CUSTOMER to use as requester_id on a new case. role_id comes from kayako_list_roles. Collaborator/agent/admin roles also require email and team_ids. No password is set by this tool. Kayako: POST /api/v1/users.json.

email.description: Primary email. Required for collaborator/agent/admin roles.

field_values.description: Custom field values keyed by field key, e.g. {"order_number": "1234"}. For multi-select fields pass CSV options — ALL options must be passed; omitted ones are removed.

organization_case_access.description: CUSTOMER only: see only own cases (default) or the whole organization's.

name: kayako_create_user
title: Create a user
